CREATE TEMP TABLE "scope_owners" AS SELECT "__path","id","scope" FROM (SELECT n.__path,n.id,coalesce(CASE WHEN cls.__start>=fn.__start AND cls.__end<=fn.__end OR fn.id IS NULL THEN cls.id ELSE fn.id END,(SELECT id FROM nodes root WHERE root.__path=n.__path AND root.kind='module' LIMIT 1)) AS scope FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id LEFT JOIN nodes fn ON fn.__path=own.__path AND fn.id=own.fn LEFT JOIN nodes cls ON cls.__path=own.__path AND cls.id=own.cls)

SELECT DISTINCT __path,id FROM (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','for_statement','for_in_clause','assignment','delete_statement','block','if_statement','elif_clause','match_statement') UNION SELECT __path,parent FROM nodes WHERE kind='for_in_clause' AND parent IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT child.__path,child.id FROM nodes child JOIN nodes cmp ON cmp.__path=child.__path AND cmp.id=child.parent WHERE cmp.kind='comparison_operator' UNION SELECT __path,name_id FROM nodes WHERE name_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,left_id FROM nodes WHERE left_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,right_id FROM nodes WHERE right_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,value_id FROM nodes WHERE value_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,type_id FROM nodes WHERE type_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,function_id FROM nodes WHERE function_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,arguments_id FROM nodes WHERE arguments_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,object_id FROM nodes WHERE object_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,body_id FROM nodes WHERE body_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,parameters_id FROM nodes WHERE parameters_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,condition_id FROM nodes WHERE condition_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,consequence_id FROM nodes WHERE consequence_start IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT __path,id FROM arguments) WHERE __path IS NOT NULL AND id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TEMP TABLE "call_paths" AS SELECT "__path","id","path" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE names(__path,id,path) AS (SELECT __path,id,text FROM py_names UNION SELECT n.__path,e.dst,n.path||e.suffix FROM names n JOIN path_edges e ON e.__path=n.__path AND e.src=n.id) SELECT * FROM names)

CREATE TEMP TABLE "name_sites" AS SELECT n.__path,n.id,n.text,n.__start,o.fn,f.__start AS fn_start,f.__end AS fn_end,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bindings store WHERE store.__path=n.__path AND store.target=n.id) AS is_store,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM bindings b JOIN nodes t ON t.__path=b.__path AND t.id=b.target WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=o.fn AND t.text=n.text) AS binding_count,
 (SELECT b.target FROM bindings b JOIN nodes t ON t.__path=b.__path AND t.id=b.target WHERE b.__path=n.__path AND b.fn=o.fn AND t.text=n.text AND b.__start<n.__start ORDER BY b.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_target
 FROM nodes n JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id JOIN functions f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn WHERE n.kind='identifier'

CREATE TEMP TABLE "propagation" AS SELECT __path,object AS src,id AS dst FROM attributes
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id
 WHERE n.kind IN ('parenthesized_expression','type','await','unary_operator','list','tuple','set','list_splat','expression_list','pattern_list')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id
 WHERE n.kind IN ('boolean_operator','conditional_expression') AND (n.kind!='conditional_expression' OR c.ordinal IN (0,2))
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN fields f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.owner=n.id AND f.role='value' JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.id=f.child WHERE n.kind IN ('pair','named_expression')
 UNION SELECT n.__path,c.id,n.id FROM nodes n JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id WHERE n.kind='dictionary'
 UNION SELECT c.__path,c.receiver,c.id FROM calls c WHERE c.receiver IS NOT NULL AND c.callee NOT IN ('async_pipeline_execution_scope','get_lowering_context','native_pipeline_execution_receipt','pipeline_execution_scope')
 UNION SELECT c.__path,a.id,c.id FROM calls c JOIN arguments a ON a.__path=c.__path AND a.call=c.id AND a.position=0 WHERE c.callee='getattr'
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.value,b.target FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target WHERE l.kind NOT IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern')
 UNION SELECT b.__path,rv.id,lt.id FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=b.__path AND r.id=b.value
 JOIN nodes lt ON lt.__path=l.__path AND lt.parent=l.id JOIN nodes rv ON rv.__path=r.__path AND rv.parent=r.id AND rv.ordinal=lt.ordinal
 WHERE l.kind IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern') AND r.kind IN ('expression_list','tuple','list')
 UNION SELECT b.__path,b.value,lt.id FROM bindings b JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=b.__path AND l.id=b.target JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=b.__path AND r.id=b.value JOIN nodes lt ON lt.__path=l.__path AND lt.parent=l.id
 WHERE l.kind IN ('pattern_list','tuple_pattern','list_pattern') AND r.kind NOT IN ('expression_list','tuple','list')
 UNION SELECT p.__path,p.id,n.id FROM name_sites p JOIN name_sites n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.text=p.text
 WHERE NOT n.is_store AND p.fn_start<=n.fn_start AND p.fn_end>=n.fn_end AND (p.fn=n.fn OR n.binding_count=0)
 AND (n.binding_count<=1 OR p.id=n.latest_target)
 UNION SELECT m.__path,m.subject_kind||':'||m.subject_start||':'||m.subject_end,n.id FROM nodes m
 JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent
 WHERE m.kind='match_statement' AND n.kind='identifier' AND (p.kind IN ('as_pattern','splat_pattern') OR (p.kind='dotted_name' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes cp WHERE cp.__path=p.__path AND cp.id=p.parent AND cp.kind='case_pattern' AND rx_matches(cp.text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*$'))))
 UNION SELECT p.__path,p.id,n.id FROM attributes p JOIN attributes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.attr=p.attr WHERE p.object_text IN ('self','cls') AND n.object_text IN ('self','cls')

CREATE TEMP TABLE "nodes" AS SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)
